import struct

# Create a simple VBA compressed file
data = bytearray()

# 3-byte header
data.extend(b'\x00\x00\x00')

# Flag byte: all literals
data.append(0x00)
data.extend(b'\x41' * 8)  # 8 literal bytes

# Flag byte: first bit compressed, rest literals
data.append(0x01)
data.extend(b'\x42' * 7)  # 7 literal bytes

# Compressed token: distance=7, len=3 (copy from start)
token = (7 << 12) | 0
data.extend(struct.pack('<H', token))

with open('/workspace/poc.bin', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(data)
print(f'Created PoC: {len(data)} bytes')
print(f'Hex: {data.hex()}')
"
